name: glab
description: GitLab workflow automation using glab CLI

interface.shortDescription: GitLab workflow automation using glab CLI
interface.longDescription: Automates GitLab workflows using the glab CLI. Covers creating and managing merge requests and issues, reviewing diffs, checking pipeline status, and following GitLab git best practices. The skill auto-detects the GitLab host from the git remote, so no extra configuration is needed when working inside a repository. Use this skill for any task that involves interacting with GitLab resources from the command line.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glab skill for this task.
